unit.why: A single narrative about the Besht granting R. Shmeril a son at the cost of his wealth, with a hearsay chain and a note on the narrator's later acquaintance with the son.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מהרב ר' פאלק הכהן שחמיו
stories.summary_en: R. Shmeril has no son and is too ashamed to ask the Besht, who lodges with him; the Besht perceives this and, staff in hand, tells his wife she will bear a son. A son, R. David, is born, but the Besht explains that heaven offered a choice between money and a son, so Shmeril loses all his wealth and becomes a preacher.
